controles.affirmation: Preuve citee : "Northern Trust faces intense competition from a wide range of financial institutions and service companies" (attribuee au 10-K FY2025)
controles.verbatim_source: Cette phrase anglaise n'existe nulle part dans data-lake/NTRS/10K/NTRS_2026-02-24.htm.gz ni dans _risks_src_30k.txt. Il s'agit d'une retraduction en anglais de la synthese francaise de src/data/v2-pipeline/ntrs.json ("concurrence intense de la part d'un large eventail d'institutions financieres et de societes de services"), presentee comme un verbatim de source. Le 10-K dit : "We are subject to intense competition in all aspects of our businesses, which could have a negative effect on our ability to maintain satisfactory prices and grow our earnings." et "We compete against large, well-capitalized, and geographically diverse companies that are capable of offering a wide array of financial products and services at competitive prices."
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer le faux verbatim par le verbatim reel du 10-K : "We are subject to intense competition in all aspects of our businesses, which could have a negative effect on our ability to maintain satisfactory prices and grow our earnings." Le fond de l'affirmation (concurrence intense) est exact ; seule la citation est fabriquee.
